# `hk config`

- **Usage:** `hk config <SUBCOMMAND>`
- **Aliases:** `cfg`
- **Effect:** read-only

Configuration introspection and management

View and inspect hk's configuration from all sources. Configuration is merged from multiple sources in precedence order: CLI flags > Environment variables > Git config (local) > XDG config > Git config (global) > Project config (hk.pkl) > Built-in defaults.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
